scope: Evidence and checkout compatibility improvement; no claim of sales increase

card.name: psyoung82 Furniture
card.description: Furniture shop. Best available prices: lamp 100, chair 180, bookshelf 260. Immediate quotes and acceptance at these prices. Ed25519-signed receipts.

skills.name: Negotiate a purchase
skills.description: Ask for an item, then send a price. The shop answers with a counteroffer or a receipt.

diagnosis: Only one Round 2 visit was recorded at inspection; evidence is insufficient to attribute low sales to the new prices.
The observed chair negotiation ended after offers of 150 and 160, below the fixed reserve 180. Buyer maximum budget is unknown.
Code inspection found that first-message offers were ignored and text-only acceptance was not recognized. These are compatibility defects, not proven causes of the observed cancellation.
change: Recognize explicit offers in the first message.
Recognize short explicit acceptance of an existing quoted price.
Only interpret complete supported offer phrases; avoid taking a budget or arbitrary number as a purchase commitment.
preserved: Seller identity, public URL and keys
remaining_limit: Other buyers control shop selection. Price and checkout changes cannot guarantee visits or sales.
